title: Add four new Note categories to Notes filters and Add/Edit Note modal

requirements.summary: Append four new category filter tabs (LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family) to the Notes page and ensure filtering matches categories exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Notes page, the category filter tab row includes: All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other, LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
Clicking each new tab filters the notes list to only notes whose category exactly matches that tab name (e.g., "Food Service").
The new tabs use the same Button variants, spacing, hover behavior, and active styling logic as existing tabs.
All existing tabs remain present and unchanged in label and behavior.

file_operations.description: Extend the Notes page category filter union/type and the categories array by appending "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family" after the existing tabs, keeping existing labels/order unchanged. Ensure the tab rendering continues to use the existing shadcn-ui Button styling/active-state logic for identical look and behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Append four new categories (LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family) to the Add Note modal Category dropdown without changing existing options.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Add Note modal, the Category select includes options for: LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
All pre-existing Category options remain present and unchanged.
A user can create a note with each of the new categories selected, and the note saves successfully.

file_operations.description: Update the CategoryOption type and the Category SelectContent to append new SelectItem options for "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family" while keeping all existing options unchanged. Continue using the existing shadcn-ui Select component patterns to preserve styling/behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure Edit Note modal supports the same four new categories and can preselect and save them without type/validation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: When editing a note, the Category select includes options for: LDC, Food Service, Personal, Family.
If an existing note has category "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", or "Family", opening the Edit Note modal preselects and displays that category correctly.
Saving an edited note with any of the new categories succeeds.

file_operations.description: Ensure edit-mode initialization and CategoryOption typing include the four new categories so notes with those categories are correctly set as Select value and can be re-saved without type/validation issues, keeping the rest of the modal unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
